summary: Creates a planar four-sided polygon sized explicitly, from a camera view frustum, or from an input SOP bounding box.

key_params.name: orient
key_params.note: Major plane or Fill Camera View orientation

key_params.name: camera
key_params.note: Camera used for Fill Camera View

common_gotchas: Rectangle SOP creates one four-sided polygon, not a subdivided grid.
Size and center change meaning in camera or input-bounds modes, acting as scale and offset.
Camera Aspect matches texture-friendly aspect ratio but does not replace a full camera projection setup.
key_concepts: Rectangle SOP creates a single planar four-sided polygon.
It can be sized directly, from a camera fill view, or from the bounds of an input SOP.
When driven by camera or bounds modes, size acts as scale and center acts as offset.
Texture and normal toggles control whether uv and N attributes are created on the rectangle.
